meta_description: 925 likes, 18 comments - ted on October 23, 2026: "Pull up a barstool (and a high chair) for the “Witching Hour,” the toddler-friendly gathering hosted by writer Stacy McLachlan. In her @tedxvancouver Talk, she explores why the early years of parenting can be so lonely — and makes the case for creating spaces where kids are free to be kids and parents are free to be people, all together. Visit the link in @TED's bio to watch the full talk.".
